questions.text: You can download openSUSE images from get.opensuse.org.
The new installer in Leap 16 is called YaST.
Btrfs is the default filesystem in openSUSE.
openSUSE Aeon uses KDE Plasma by default.
Slowroll is a Tumbleweed variant with updates in tested batches.
The first openSUSE.Asia Summit was held in Taipei.
Myrlyn is the new package manager GUI replacing YaST.
The installer of openSUSE Aeon is called Agama.
Leap Micro is the only openSUSE immutable distro with point releases.

spare_questions.text: openSUSE bugs should be reported on GitHub Issues.
You can play Windows games on openSUSE with Steam.
The openSUSE infrastructure team is called the openSUSE Heroes.
The 2019 openSUSE.Asia Summit was held in Jakarta.
The openSUSE project was founded at a conference in Nuremberg.
You can stay on Leap 16 only until 2028.
Vietnam has hosted an openSUSE.Asia Summit.
Tokyo hosted the openSUSE.Asia Summit in 2017 and 2024.
Summit logos are picked through a community design contest.
The default shell in openSUSE is zsh.
